senses.gloss: m. (דרר) a large barrel carried on wheels, or rolled.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:1">Kel. XV, 1</cite> <he>ד׳ עגלה</he> a water tank on wheels. Sifra Sh’mini ch. VII, Par. 6 <he>מוציא דרור עגלה</he> (corr. acc.). Ib. <he>ארבה ד׳ עגלה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 538">Yalk. Lev. 538</cite> <cite ref="D01051"><he>דַּרְדַּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 30:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXX</cite> (ref. to <he>חמת</he> <cite ref="Genesis 21:14">Gen. XXI, 14</cite>) <he>לקח את הד׳ וכ׳</he> Abraham took the water barrel and tied it to her loins that it might drag behind her &c. [<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 115:2">Sifré Num. 115</cite>, read <cite ref="T00250"><he>רְדִיד</he></cite>, as <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:1">Yalk. ib. 750</cite>.]—Pl. <he>דַּרְדּוּרִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:5">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:5">V</cite>), 5 (Var. <he>הדרורין</he>); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 32a:5">Ab. Zar. 32ᵃ</cite>.

(ed. <he>דוד׳</he>, corr. acc.). [<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 992">Yalk. Cant. 992</cite> <he>דרדורי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D01051"><he>דַּרְדַּר</he></cite>.]
